g.text: INTERACTIVE TEXTBOOK • BIOLOGY 7-10 • STATIC SVG SIMULATION
WORD BANK • DRAG THESE LABELS TO THE SLOTS
Drag a label from the word bank to its matching dashed slot.
Follow the arrow — it points to the exact part on the flower.
Use Hint if stuck, Check Answer to reveal correct mapping.
Reset clears the board. No JavaScript — pure SVG :target.
2. Pollen sticks to stigma → travels down style
3. Ovary becomes fruit, ovules become seeds
• Petal = large colorful part that attracts pollinators.
• Sepal = green leaf-like under petals, protects bud.
• Stigma = sticky top of pistil where pollen lands.
• Style = long tube connecting stigma to ovary.
• Anther = yellow tip of stamen that makes pollen.
• Filament = stalk that holds anther up.
• Receptacle = thickened stem where all parts attach.

text.tspan: - Anther makes pollen, filament holds it.
- Stigma receives pollen, style guides tube,

g.text: If 8/10 correct, you mastered flower anatomy!
